what.text: This page follows Tibetan refugees in India as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year from 1964 to 1974.
At the end of 1974, the last year in UNHCR's series for this group, it counted 59900 refugees, 88.1% of all Tibetan refugees it counted that year.
In 2025 the largest number of Tibetan refugees in UNHCR's data live in Nepal.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1964 to 1974.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1964 at 44000 refugees.
The figure rose to its highest point at the end of 1974, when the series ends.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in India.
These are year-end totals for India only, reported to UNHCR, and the series ends in 1974.
